title: "It from Bit": The Hartle-Hawking state and quantum mechanics for de Sitter observers
summary: The one-state statement for closed universes has sparked considerable discussion. In this paper, we examine its physical meaning in the context of the Hartle-Hawking state and de Sitter space. We argue that the one-state property of closed universes is fully compatible with the finite-dimensional quantum mechanics experienced by observers inside de Sitter space, and that this compatibility requires neither mixing of $α$-sectors nor any modification of the rules of the gravitational path integral.
